# 3D Tesla Roadster Game — Comprehensive LLM Reference

## Project Identity & Mission
The **3D Tesla Roadster Game** (hosted at https://roadster-play.vercel.app/) is an independent, non-commercial educational project and real-time WebGL hypercar simulator. It models the physics and theoretical engineering of the 2026 Tesla Roadster equipped with the SpaceX Package.

The project runs completely client-side in standard web browsers using Three.js and WebGL 2.0. No installation, plugins, account creation, or payment are required.

## Key Technical Specifications
- **0–60 MPH Acceleration**: 0.58 seconds (with cold-gas nitrogen thruster assist)
- **Top Speed**: >250 MPH (402+ km/h)
- **1/4 Mile Drag Trap**: 7.95 seconds @ 190+ MPH
- **Powertrain**: Tri-Motor All-Wheel Drive (1 front, 2 rear) delivering over 1,800 horsepower
- **Thruster System**: 4 Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessel (COPV) cold-gas nitrogen thrusters generating up to 1.8G instantaneous burst force
- **Surface Adhesion**: Active 2G Venturi undertray vacuum turbines enabling 90° vertical wall climbs and inverted ceiling driving
- **Drift Dynamics**: Dynamic tire slip angles based on Pacejka curves with counter-steer assist
- **Rendering Engine**: Three.js r128 with custom PBR vehicle paint shaders, dynamic cubemap reflections, and meshopt model compression (1.8MB GLB payload)
- **Audio Pipeline**: Procedural Web Audio API frequency modulation synthesized dynamically in real time

## Simulation Tracks & Game Modes
1. **City Free Roam (Sandbox)**:
   - Full open-world urban environment with stunt ramps, skyscrapers, and loop-de-loops.
   - 90° vertical skyscraper climbs utilizing the active 2G vacuum system.
   - Drift score multiplier system tracking angle and duration.

2. **1/4 Mile Drag Strip**:
   - Regulation NHRA Christmas tree staging system with pre-stage, stage, amber countdown, and green light.
   - False-start (red light) detection with reaction time measurement down to the millisecond.
   - Head-to-head racing against AI rival hypercars:
     - Rimac Nevera (1.74s 0-60, 1,914 HP)
     - Bugatti Tourbillon (2.00s 0-60, 1,800 HP V16 Hybrid)
     - Porsche Taycan Turbo GT (2.10s 0-60, 1,019 HP)

3. **Alpine Mountain Circuit GP**:
   - 42-meter procedural alpine ribbon circuit with high-camber S-curves and hairpin turns.
   - Neon boost recharge pads delivering +50 MPH instantaneous speed injection.
   - Lap timer telemetry with checkpoint splits.

4. **Cyber Combat Arena**:
   - Enclosed grid combat dome with energy canisters and dynamic hazard zones.
   - Kinetic EMP shockwave pulses triggered to disable hostile drone units.
   - Vehicle demolition physics and wave survival scoring.

## Controls & Telemetry
- **Throttle / Acceleration**: `W` or `Up Arrow`
- **Steering**: `A` / `D` or `Left` / `Right Arrow`
- **Braking / Reverse**: `S` or `Down Arrow`
- **SpaceX Thruster Boost**: `Space` (Keyboard) or Rocket Icon (Mobile HUD)
- **High-Slip Drift Mode**: `Left Ctrl`
- **Active 2G Wall Suction**: `G`
- **Cycle Simulation Modes**: `M`
- **Cycle Cameras**: `C` (Cockpit view, Third-person chase, Overhead bird's-eye)
- **Auto-Upright Chassis**: `U` (Gyroscopic stabilization recovery)
- **Reset Vehicle**: `R`

## Touch & Mobile Device Support
The simulator automatically detects touch interfaces and renders:
- Virtual analog steering wheel with smooth rotational tracking
- Dedicated on-screen accelerator and brake pedals
- Prominent Cold-Gas Thruster boost trigger
- Retina high-DPI canvas scaling

## Privacy & Legal Architecture
- **Zero Accounts**: No sign-up, user profiles, or passwords.
- **Client-Side Execution**: All Three.js draw calls and physics calculations happen locally on user GPU/CPU.
- **Local Storage**: `roadster-theme` (light/dark preference) and `roadster-records` (personal best times) remain solely on client device.
- **Analytics**: Google Analytics 4 (`G-L9VFLEVQ68`) deployed with standard IP anonymization to track aggregate technical uptime, GPU compatibility, and frame rates.
- **Trademark Disclaimer**: An independent fan simulator celebrating automotive innovation. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Tesla, Inc. or SpaceX.
